title: nixos/dex: add `package` option
reason: Applicable: real dex module + wired test (dex-oidc = handleTest ./dex-oidc.nix {}; at head). Real diff adds a genuinely new `package` mkPackageOption declaration (mkPackageOption pkgs "dex-oidc" {}), replacing hardcoded pkgs.dex-oidc references with cfg.package throughout.
targets_toml: single target dex, cfg_ident=cfg, option_prefix=[services,dex], watch=[package].

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: SECOND INSTANCE of the mkPackageOption non-discovery pattern first seen in batch1 PR463848 (gonic): package is declared via `mkPackageOption pkgs "dex-oidc" {}` (not a literal mkOption call) and remains OptionNotFound even at head where it genuinely exists -- audit-diff correctly classifies this as unchanged=1 (no transition, both sides identically not-found), so nothing renders as notable, but this is real, reproducible evidence (now 2/2 occurrences) that mkPackageOption declarations specifically are not discovered by the declaration walker. candidate_capability_gap, now with 2 independent corroborating instances.
